description: Recursively crawl a website starting from a URL, following internal links up to a specified depth. Returns markdown content for each page visited.

includeHtml.description: Include raw HTML alongside markdown (default: false)

includeLinks.description: Add each page's links to its result (default: false)

includeOnly.description: Only follow URLs containing one of these strings (* matches anything); the start URL is always crawled

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (default: 10)

mainContent.description: Extract only main content from each page (default: true)

maxDepth.description: Maximum link depth to follow from the start URL (default: 2)

name: crawl
